BA-105 (2026-10-12): open_ended stage becomes artifact-pinned fielded content

notes: v1 (2026-10-12, BA-105): artifact-pins the open_ended follow-up pair verbatim from the code-defined stage introduced in UX round 8. Stored instrument_id on new sessions is 'open_ended.tp_followup' (artifact id); sessions on unbound manifests keep their legacy 'open_ended_followup' rows — the codebook documents both.

Stage policy: the open_ended stage exists on TP variants only when a manifest binds this slot (instruments.open_ended). Profiles without the pin run post_questionnaire -> debrief with no injected stage; historical manifests are unchanged.
response.type 'free_text': min/max carry character bounds (0..4000); items are validated as non-blank prose, never numerically scored.

items.text: There was no single right way to approach this task, and people worked through it very differently. Briefly, how did you decide on a location for each of your crates?
When you weren't sure about a crate, how did you decide which source to rely on: your case file, the team chat, or the AI assistant?
